newsitem.title: GERMANY: Two hurt by firebombing of Turkish club in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt by firebombing of Turkish club in Germany.

text.p: German police said on Wednesday two people were slightly injured in an early morning fire caused by unknown assailants who threw firebombs into a Turkish cultural club in the southwestern town of Goeppingen.
Police said the two injured Turkish men had been sleeping in the club when the assailants smashed a ground floor window and threw two firebombs into the building shortly after 2 a.m. (0100 GMT).
Police officers who arrived at the scene before the fire department put out the blaze with fire extinguishers.

Authorities said that two men in the club suffered from minor cuts and that the fire caused about 15,000 marks ($9,500) in damage. They said they were investigating, but had no firm leads on the assailants.
Germany was hit by a wave of right-wing violence directed at foreigners in the early 1990s that killed dozens, including many Turks who had been living in Germany for years.
